headline: Track projects, invoices, and revisions effortlessly
value_proposition: Bilingual Arabic and English, built for local freelancing habits, with no subscriptions that lock users in and no collection of client data.
features: Track client projects with organized templates
Manage invoices sent and revision rounds in one place
Built for local freelancing habits in Arabic and English
No subscriptions, no client data collected
Simple and easy to use for multiple clients

faq.q: What is included in the template pack?
faq.a: The template pack includes Notion and Google Sheets templates to help you track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
The templates are available in Notion and Google Sheets formats for easy use and customization.

faq.q: Can I use the templates in both Arabic and English?
faq.a: Yes, the templates are bilingual and support both Arabic and English for local freelancing needs.

faq.q: Does the product collect client data?
faq.a: No, the product does not collect client data, ensuring your privacy and security.

faq.q: What does the product not do?
faq.a: The product does not include payment integration, user accounts, or dynamic content. It is a static template pack for tracking and organizing client information.

claims.claim: Notion's Freelance templates are designed for independent professionals, offering project proposals, client management tools, invoice trackers, and time management sheets.
claims.quote: Empower your freelance journey with Notion's Freelance templates. Designed for independent professionals, our collection includes project proposals, client management tools, invoice trackers, and time management sheets.

claims.claim: Sync2Sheets offers a 7-day free trial for real-time 2-way sync between Notion databases and Google Sheets.
claims.quote: install Sync2Sheets in Google Sheets (7-day free trial, no credit card), connect your Notion workspace, and pick the databases you want to sync.
